snippet.title: nail'd - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
nail'd coming for PC, PS3 and X360.

http://www.naildgame.com/

Steep slopes, suddenly appearing obstacles and surprising turns in the track demand sharp reflexes, requiring players to give their all. Through its insane bursts of speed, nail'd will catapult you from one adrenalin boost to the next.
